description: Defines data structures, enums, and functions related to NGAP location reporting in a 3GPP context, including Area of Interest, UE presence, and location report request handling.

classes.name: ngap_area_of_interest
classes.description: Represents an area of interest with lists of TAI, cell IDs, and RAN node IDs.

classes.name: ngap_area_of_interest_item
classes.description: An item containing an area of interest and a report reference ID.

classes.name: ngap_ue_presence_in_area_of_interest_item
classes.description: Represents UE presence status within an area of interest.

classes.name: ngap_location_report_request
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for requesting location reports, including event type, report area, and interest list.

classes.name: ngap_location_report
classes.description: Contains details of a location report, including UE index, user location info, and request details.

classes.name: ngap_location_report_failure_indication
classes.description: Indicates failure in location reporting with UE index and cause.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the event_type enum into a string representation.
